body:
## Problem

`deepseek-v4-pro` is currently charged at Flash rates by the default pricing policy for requests on or after 2026-09-14 04:00 UTC. This was introduced in #6974 based on the original September 10 retirement announcement.

DeepSeek subsequently confirmed that V4 Pro remains available after September 14 with unchanged billing. The current pricing page identifies it as `DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813` and lists separate Pro prices:

- [Current model pricing](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing/)
- [Updated change log](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/updates/)

## Change

- Remove the date-based Pro-to-Flash pricing switch and its obsolete comments.
- Keep Pro on its existing Pro rates, including versioned Pro names. Preserve Flash rates, peak/off-peak calculation, and group/channel pricing overrides.
- Update the existing pricing test expectations; no additional test files or broad refactoring.

For example, 1,000 uncached input tokens + 500 output tokens + 1,000 cached input tokens at off-peak should cost **$0.001672** for Pro. The current policy charges **$0.000453** using Flash rates.

This corrects future default Pro billing and default account-cost estimates. It does not rewrite historical usage records or alter custom channel prices.

## Redacted official billing evidence

An official DeepSeek usage/cost CSV export contains the following daily Pro aggregate for **2026-10-10 (UTC+8, off-peak)**. Only the date, model, token categories, quantities, and billed amounts are reproduced; account identifiers, API key names/values, and the original files are omitted.

| Pro token category | Tokens | Official CNY / 1M tokens | Calculated CNY |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Uncached input | 1,293,618 | 4.50 | 5.8212810 |
| Output | 70,643 | 13.50 | 0.9536805 |
| Cached input | 47,868,544 | 0.15 | 7.1802816 |
| Total | | | **13.9552431** |

The calculated total exactly matches the corresponding official cost-export aggregate. At Flash off-peak CNY rates, the same usage would instead total **2.53356088 CNY**. This is evidence of distinct Pro billing, not a claim about the provider's internal model routing. The CNY evidence is not converted to USD; the code retains the official USD prices already defined in the repository.

## Validation

- Go 1.27.2; golangci-lint 2.14.0.
- Updated existing Pro assertions fail on the original billing implementation (expected `$0.001672`, actual `$0.000453`) and pass with this fix.
- `go test -tags=unit ./internal/service -run '(Deepseek|DeepSeek)' -count=1` — passed.
- `go build ./...` — passed.
- `golangci-lint run --timeout=30m ./...` — passed, 0 issues.
- `git diff --check` — passed.
- Full backend unit suite (`go test -tags=unit ./...`, with proxy environment variables unset): one unrelated failure in `TestValidateCreateParams_CheckModeMatrix/probe_requires_api_key`. Local DNS makes the test endpoint fail public-host validation before the missing-key check. The identical failure was reproduced with both changed files replaced by unmodified upstream `3a6fd1c9` through a Go build overlay. No channel-monitor code or tests were changed.

The full unit suite is therefore **not claimed green** locally. An initial proxy-related captcha transport test failure disappeared when proxy variables were unset. Integration/frontend checks are left to CI; neither area is modified by this PR.
title: fix(billing): retain DeepSeek V4 Pro pricing after September 14
